cohort: The study included 200 antenatal women at >=32 weeks' gestation, comprising 100 high-risk and 100 low-risk women, who delivered within 24 hours of admission.
finding: Admission CTG served as a valuable triage tool for early risk stratification, with reactive patterns predicting favorable outcomes and non-reactive/ominous tracings strongly predicting adverse perinatal events.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rates were significantly higher in cases with non-reactive CTG (63.63%) compared to reactive CTG (39.21%), and all patients with ominous CTG underwent emergency cesarean section (100%).
